tagline: St. James’ Orthodox Church — Syrian Christian Heritage, Sanjay Lake & Eco Trails

overview.short: St. James’ Orthodox Church in Mayur Vihar Phase-3 is a revered Syrian Orthodox parish celebrated for its ancient St. Thomas Christian liturgy and vibrant cultural community.
overview.description: Founded under the Malankara Orthodox Syrian Church (Diocese of Delhi), St. James’ Orthodox Church in Mayur Vihar Phase-3 is a focal point of Eastern Christian heritage in the capital. Preserving two millennia of ancient St. Thomas Christian traditions, Syriac hymns, and distinctive architecture, the church serves a vibrant community. The surrounding Mayur Vihar and trans-Yamuna precinct features tranquil nature destinations like Sanjay Lake, Okhla Bird Sanctuary, and Smriti Van.
overview.about: The church is famous for its solemn Holy Qurbana services conducted in Malayalam, English, and Syriac. It represents the rich multicultural tapestry of Trans-Yamuna Delhi with easy access to Noida expressways, cultural campuses, and riverine wetlands.

howToReach.roadNote: Connected via Noida Electronic City Metro (Blue Line) and Mayur Vihar Phase-3 bus terminal. Direct access via NH24 / Delhi-Meerut Expressway.
